title: nut cracker
text: nut cracker. I purchased three different nutcrackers... including this one.  This particular nutcracker is by far the best.  It is the easiest to use. You need just a tiny bit of grip strength to crack the nut, gently done - not smashed.  I mainly crack walnuts with it.  But it has cracked every nut I have tried.  It's heavy.  All parts are metal - appear to be cast.  The main body is black, the handle is silver.  It appears to be quite sturdy and heavy duty.  I've only used it for about a week - however, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  It shows no evidence of breaking or weakness.  I hope this info was helpful to you in some way.
